title: Open Logix remote config
description: What one Open Logix component uses: one entry per direct dependency, naming a stable GitHub release and its file. A component reads remote-config/<product>/config-NNN.jsonc from its own repo, by the config version it hard-codes (Remote updates, in the website repo's CLAUDE.md). The file is JSONC: comments say why each entry changed.

dependency.description: A dependency, keyed by its package name, such as logix-catalog.

repo.description: The GitHub repo of its releases, owner/name, such as openlogix/logix-catalog.

release.description: The release tag, yyyy-mm-dd. It must be a stable release (not a pre-release).

file.description: The release file's name, a template: ${PLATFORM} is the platform, such as darwin-arm64, and ${YYYYMMDD} the release tag without dashes. Such as logix-core-${PLATFORM}-${YYYYMMDD}.tgz.
